Summary: Blunt and unbending, that is Akemi in a nutshell. She isn't one to sugar-coat, she will speak her mind and tell things how it is. Her fighting spirit made her one of the best students of the school in physical culture, and especially in archery. But in her personal life, she keeps everyone at a distance, and the people she could call friends can be counted on fingers.
Appearance: ear-length blond hair, brown eyes, fit, fair skin, average height, usually wears red&white bomber jacket over her school attire.

entries.name: Sakura Kudō
entries.content:
Name: Sakura Kudō.
Class: 3-1.
Club: A member of the archery club, and one of its best participants, sharing a place on a par with Akemi Watarai.
Summary: A lovely girl, the daughter of a priest of the temple, brought up in strictness and modesty, embodying the restrained beauty of the mentality of her native country, carrying out an air of mystery and longing around her.
Appearance: Long dark purple hair tied into braid, muddy purple eyes, pale complexion, average height, slender yet curvy, big chest, wears ordinary school attire.

entries.name: Miyū Kimura
entries.content:
Name: Miyū Kimura
Class: 2-4
Club: None.
Summary: A playful and friendly gyaru girl. Despite her goofy behavior and cute social habits, she is one of the main nests of local gossip, though a few knows about it. She willingly uses her image, playing and manipulating people for entertainment. She also secretly goes on paid dates, getting money and gifts from older men through the bed, to satisfy her egoistic and mercantile aims. Keeps friendship with Utako Moriyama, fellow gyaru girl.
Appearance: Shoulder-length brown hair, hazel eyes, light skin, short height, curvaceous yet little plump body, ample chest, wears casual school attire which loosened.

entries.name: Mami Okimoto
entries.content:
Name: Mami Okimoto.
Occupation: Teacher of English language.
Summary: A new school teacher who seems to be a little to airheaded for this job. She it not the smartest the person for sure, but if you will give her a chance she can be really a really good friend. Very energetic and responsive young woman, often communicating with students on the same level. Also very restless and clumsy.
Appearance: Lush and puffy long ginger hair, orange eyes, average height, fair skin, curvaceous body with big chest, usually wears red leather jacket over her teacher attire.

entries.name: Suzu Kuratsune
entries.content:
Name: Suzu Kuratsune
Class: 3-4.
Club: None.
Summary: A girl with excellent manners and appearance, and at the same time an extremely bad reputation among the women: she regularly seduces guys, forcing them to fall in love with her, even if they have a girlfriend already, and then flings them, as if having lost all interest, immediately switching to the next target. Despite that, she is popular not only with those who are just looking for sex, but also with naive romantics who apparently think they can fix her.
Appearance: ash white loose hair, cyan eyes, fair skin, slender yet curvy build, big chest, average height, wears casual school attire.

entries.name: Chiaki Kawa
entries.content:
Name: Chiaki Kawa
Class: 2-3
Club: Cooking club
Summary: Chiaki is a cute and bubbly girl that somehow tends to draw the attention of others like a magnet. She enjoy helping others and naively believes everyone to be as good natured as herself. Chiaki is possibly one of the kindest students at the school, unfortunately to a fault as she allows herself to be taken advantage of and is afraid of confrontations.
Appearance: Puffy red bob haircut, red eyes, fair skin, short height, medium chest, slender, wearing cute school uniform with lots of ribbons and garters.

entries.name: Mayuko Wakana
entries.content:
Name: Mayuko Wakana.
Occupation: Math teacher.
Summary: Harsh teacher with a rather bad and abrasive temper. Embittered by the stress of divorce process.
Appearance: brown hair tied into topknot, dark brown eyes, light skin, above average height, large chest, curvaceous body, wears strict black teacher dress suit.

entries.name: Kei Hamada
entries.content:
Name: Kei Hamada
Class: 3-2
Club: Captain of Swimclub
Summary: Kei is a girl who despite her short stature is often looked up to as a big sis to all her peers at the academy. Perhaps it is her helpful nature or how approachable she is and gets along with everyone.
Appearance: Long brown hair with opened forehead fixed by hairpin, tanned skin, green eyes, average height, sizeable chest, slim yet curvy, wearing casual school attire.

entries.name: Emi Fukuzawa
entries.content:
Name: Emi Fukuzawa.
Class: 2-2.
Club: None.
Summary: A girl whose life is very closely associated with music, and whom you will probably see with a guitar. Her main dream is to perform with her own band and gain acknowledgement after years of ignoring her talents and bullying.
Appearance: short green hair tied in two side tails, green eyes, petite body, light skin, small chest, average height, wears casual school attrie with yellow&black bomber jacket, often can be see with guitar bag.

entries.name: Jun Suzuki
entries.content:
Name: Jun Suzuki
Occupation: School medic.
Summary: Touchy and lethargic school medic who can often be found in her medical office, sleeping or chilling.
Appearance: Long black hair tied into braid, black eyes, pale skin, slender body, small chest, average height, wears medic white coat over her casual clothes.

entries.name: Kevin Kaas
entries.content:
Name: Kevin Kaas.
Occupation: Sport teacher.
Summary: Kevin is a Norwegian who moved to Japan, currently working as a teacher at the school, specializing in physical education. He is quite fit and works out majority of his time and is perfectly fine with pushing his students physically also. However, it would be a big mistake to believe that he is just a stupid jock - he's way more intelligent than he looks. Having a big heart, he is ready to develop his students both physically and mentally.
Appearance: short blond hair slicked back, stubble, blue eyes, tall, powerful build, light skin, wears mostly sport attire.

entries.name: Mana Nakamura
entries.content:
Name: Mana Nakamura.
Class: 3-1.
Club: Occult club.
Summary: As someone that has taken an interest in the occult early in her life, this has made Mana a bit of a weird and creepy girl, one especially with little to no friends in their life. Despite that she's very outgoing and open person who craves for new acquaintances, especially if those new mates of hers gonna help her to expand the popularity of her club.
Appearance: Long dark brown hair with bang falling over her eye, golden eyes, light skin, above average height, curvy, big chest, wears school attire, often adorned with dark overcoat.

entries.name: Keitashi Tsubokawa
entries.content:
Name: Keitashi Tsubokawa.
Class: 2-1.
Club: None.
Summary: The sole heir of his father's vast fortune, one of the largest financial companies in all Japan. With this, Keitashi is merely attending the school until the time he is employed within his father's company. That doesn't mean Keitashi is no slouch academically as he is quite proficient. However... He has a quite bad temperament and a tendency to get into trouble because of it.

entries.name: Miyoko Irie
entries.content:

Class: 2-3.
Club: Occult club.
Summary: Miyoko is a fairly socially active girl that likes to keep up with the latest trends in fashion and design. She likes to talk... a lot. Even much to the annoyance of her fellow classmates. She also has a tendence to wear extravagant outfits, for which she often gets reprimands from the management.

entries.name: Kyōka Ishikawa

Name: Kyōka Ishikawa.
Class: 2-1.
Club: Music club leader.
Summary: An enthusiast of the music club and its head, Kyōka is a cheerful and optimistic girl with a heart of gold, giving all of herself to her hobby and striving to make her club more popular. Despite her lovable and affable nature, inside she is consumed with envy and spite towards her older sister, hoping to surpass her one day.

entries.name: Azusa Hayashi
entries.content:
Name: Azusa Hayashi.
Class: 3-3.
Club: Drama club.
Summary: A member of the drama club and their main star, who gets the main roles thanks to acting and diction. Outwardly, a rather prim and arrogant girl, to match the reputation of the queen bee. However, under the facade of a swaggering bitch, there is a hardworking and quite empathetic person who, however, rarely shows her soft side. Currently dating Teppei Ogawa, her fellow drama club member and local popular handsome guy.

Name: Miki Yajima
Class: 2-3.
Club: None.
Summary: Very sarcastic and thorny girl who pushes most of people who tries to interact with her, keeping around her just a couple of close friends. She devotes most of her time outside of school to part-time work in order to get out of the debt hole into which her and her brother, Norio, were dragged by their father.

Name: Yūri Toda.
Class: 3-3.
Club: None.
Summary: She is a delinquent who, if you're lucky enough, will actually see at the school. When not off somewhere else enjoying herself, she is doing things other than not studying or exercising. Yūri might outwardly appear to be a lazy and rough individual, and to a degree that is true concerning attendance at the school itself. Class: 2-4.
Club: None.

Club: None.

She often gets into fights with other delinquents and attracts attention with her eccentric and strange behavior. Has a younger sister, Ikuko, who's often teases Atsuko for her weird antics.

Class: 2-2.

Appearance: Brown hair with side ponytail, brown eyes, fair skin, slender build, average height, medium chest, wears ordinary school attire with cardigan and sweater, wears glasses.

entries.name: Katsuna Kokusai Gakuen High School
entries.content:
Katsuna Kokusai Gakuen High School is a reputable high school in the city, known for its rigorous academic program and diverse student body.
It's a co-ed school with a student population of about 1500. The average number of students in the senior class is about 300. The campus is modern and well-maintained, with facilities for various sports, arts and other extracurricular activities. Unlike most schools, the local policies are less strict with respect to students, as for some items of clothing. Since the school does not have a specific uniform, students are free to wear any clothes as long as they meet the school dress code and do not stand out.
Most students at Katsuna Kokusai Gakuen are from well-off families, with a few international students as well. The school is a melting pot of different cultures, which is very enriching. The school has an additional program for exchange students from abroad for their rapid integration into society.
Most of the matters related to high school remain at the mercy of the local school student council, which has fairly broad powers, supervises order, monitors attendance, holds competitions and various events, manages the quality work of clubs, informing students and much more.

entries.name: Clubs
entries.content:
There are currently 8 active clubs in the school:
Cooking club - This club focuses on learning recipes from different cultures and countries, with an emphasis on Japanese cuisine. Activities involve cooking classes, sharing culinary traditions, and hosting meal events (~6 members).
Music club - Members learn how to write, play, and produce various forms of music. They practice and compose music, participate in concerts, and work with outside musicians (2 members).
Swim club - Members practice and train in swimming and other aquatic sports. They compete in local swimming contests, and participate in school-led swimming (~8 members).
Tea club - Members learn the history, traditions, and etiquette of Japanese tea ceremony and culture. They brew, sample, and study various types of tea, and host tea ceremony events (~6 members).
Archery club - Members learn the fundamentals of archery, from proper equipment to technique. They engage in archery practices and drills, and compete in local tournaments (~6 members).
Occult club - Members explore and study topics related to Japanese folklore, paranormal and supernatural phenomena, and the occult. They engage in discussions, research, and investigations, and sometimes perform rituals. Despite the lack of practical benefits, the club is still active (3 members).
Football club - Members practice and train in football, both individually and as a team. They participate in competitions, and develop strategies and techniques (~14 members).
Drama club - Members rehearse and practice acting, and stage plays, musicals, and other performances. They explore different drama techniques, from classical to experimental (~10 members).

entries.name: School Student Council
entries.content:
The local school student council is a student organization that holds considerable authority within this school and manages various aspects of the high school, including enforcing rules, monitoring attendance, holding events, and managing clubs. It has broad powers and is responsible for maintaining order and ensuring a positive educational environment. Every year, the election of the head of the student council takes place among its members, as well as students with an irreproachable reputation.
Current chairman of student council is Tsuna Isomoto who holds her position firmly. Other notable members of the student council include Kaori Ishikawa (the right hand responsible for discipline and attendance) and Tatsuya Matsumura (the secretary who manages the finances and oversees the activities of the clubs).

entries.name: Megumi Nakajō
entries.content:
Name: Megumi Nakajō.
Class: 2-1.
Club: Music club.
Summary: Megumi is a man of very little words. He very much keeps to himself and isn't particularly interested in socializing with others at school. More often than not, Megumi would prefer to spend time alone and self-reflect. He may come across as cold but fiercely loyal to those he is close with. One thing he has shown any kind of passion is music, and he's one of two members of new made musician club, alongside with Kyōka.

entries.name: Yū Kunishima

Class: 3-3.

entries.name: Daisuke Mitsuda
entries.content:

Class: 3-4.
Club: None.

entries.name: Tatsuya Matsumura

With how seriously he treats his academics, he is naturally designated by others to lead their clubs. If he getshe will stick his nose into the issue whether he can win the fight or not. Other students who converse with him find it helping and calming... though there's something disturbing about his gaze. Was boyfriend of Ruri in the past before they broke up.

Class: 3-1.
Club: Drama club.

There were strange rumors around him about his orientation, but only until he started dating Azusa, another star of the Drama club.

entries.name: Muzan Kirosuji

Name: Muzan Kirosuji.

Name: Wan Seong.
Class: 3-1.
Club: Football club.

Appearance: short black hair slicked back, light blue eyes, fair skin, fit body, above average height, wears ordinary school attire.

Occupation: NEET.
Summary: Kevin's teacher's female cousin, whom he brought with him to Japan at her request. Goofy weeaboo and big fan of Japanese culture (anime specifically). She often attends the school where her older male cousin works to bring him food, bask in the attention or just admire the school scenery.
